subject: Interview loop coverage for Sofia Martinez — panel staffing, surge & backfill
messages:
From: Linda Park <linda@talentbridge.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 08:32:00 -0800
Subject: Candidate loop: Sofia Martinez (Systems PM role) — target Tue 11/10

Hi Rishi,

Hope you’re well. We’d like to lock an interview loop for Sofia Martinez (resume attached) — strong systems background, final stage with hiring manager. The panel requested:
- System design (60 min)
- Product & PM fit (30 min)
- Behavioral / collaboration (30 min)

The recruiter team is aiming for Tue 11/10 between 10:00-14:00 PT to keep everything on one day. Can Redwood provide a 2-hour contiguous block + a short debrief buffer?

We’ll provide the resume (attached) and a candidate guide. If you need a backup interviewer or want to split the loop across days, happy to work with you.

Thanks,
Linda
TalentBridge — Recruiting Partner
Attachments: Sofia_Martinez_Resume.pdf

---

(On a side note: candidate is on Mountain Time and prefers morning PT slots.)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Linda Park <linda@talentbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Candidate loop: Sofia Martinez (Systems PM role) — panel staffing request

Team — quick request from TalentBridge (see below). Can you cover the loop Tues 11/10? Narrow ask: 2-hour contiguous block + 15m debrief. Prefer 10:00–12:15 PT but flexible.

Notes/constraints:
- I’m doing on-site interviews that morning and can only cover the PM fit if we push later; probably limited to 11:30–13:00 PT.
- Marcus has been at high panel load this week (2 other loops), so happy to accept a partial slot or a shadow arrangement.
- We need a confirmed backup in case someone is pulled into an escalation.

Please reply with: "Yes — full", "Yes — partial (which slot)" or "No — can backfill". If you mark partial, indicate whether you can do the system-design portion or take debrief ownership.

Rishi
VP, Recruiting Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Linda Park <linda@talentbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Candidate loop: Sofia Martinez (Systems PM role) — panel staffing request

Yes — full. I can take the behavioral/collaboration and run the debrief.
Availability: 10:00–12:30 PT on Tue 11/10.

A couple of implementation notes:
- I can be the primary debrief owner — I’ll take notes in the shared hiring doc and flag any follow-ups.
- If Marcus prefers to do design, that’s ideal. If not, I can cover a 30-min whiteboard + 30-min product slot and we swap design to a second interviewer (if needed).

Happy to volunteer.

– Neha
Senior Manager, Hiring Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 10:01:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Candidate loop: Sofia Martinez (Systems PM role) — panel staffing request

Thanks for the heads-up. I can do the system design slot but only for 60 mins starting at 11:00 PT (I’ve another panel at 09:00 and a sync at 10:30 that may run over). If we structure it as:
- 11:00–12:00: System design (Marcus)
- 12:00–12:30: PM fit (Rishi/Laura)
- 12:30–12:45: Debrief (Neha owner)

That gets awkward with the candidate’s morning preference but keeps me honest. If that pushes the loop too late, I can do a shadow model: I join the design slot remotely for 40 mins and Neha or Laura runs the hands-on portion.

Also: I’m happy to be the escalation backup if anything comes up — but I cannot be the primary interviewer earlier than 11:00.

Marcus
Staff Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Candidate loop: Sofia Martinez (Systems PM role) — panel staffing request

If the proposed 11:00 start works for Marcus, I can cover the PM fit (12:00–12:30) and take responsibility for clarifying product tradeoffs. If we need an earlier option, I can swap and do 10:00–10:30 but would need someone else to cover my 11:00–11:45 meeting (I can ask Priya for a swap).

I’ll plan to be the second debriefer if Neha needs it. Also attaching the internal candidate guide we use — includes suggested questions and scoring rubric.

Laura Bennett
Hiring Manager, Product
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Candidate_interview_guide.pdf

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Linda Park <linda@talentbridge.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:14:00 -0800
Subject: Final: Sofia Martinez loop — confirmed schedule & backfill plan

Thanks all — we’ve got a plan that keeps the candidate in the morning PT window and gives us a debrief owner. Final schedule (confirmed):
- 11:00–12:00 PT: System design — Marcus Lin (remote for first 40m if needed; will join fully at 11:10 if behind)
- 12:00–12:30 PT: PM fit — Laura Bennett
- 12:30–12:45 PT: Debrief — Neha Kapoor (owner)

Backups:
- If Marcus is pulled before 11:00, Neha can run the design as a 30-min whiteboard and Laura will extend to cover PM questions; I’ll step in for final hiring decision notes.
- Calendar invite with candidate and TalentBridge has been sent (link below).

Attachments: Sofia_Martinez_Resume.pdf, Candidate_interview_guide.pdf

Linda — thanks for being flexible on the window; I sent the confirmed invite to Sofia and TalentBridge. We’ll capture notes in the hiring doc and aim for a same-day outcome.

Rishi
VP, Recruiting Partnerships
Redwood Inference
